digest.component_or_area: LLM structured output extraction and validation
propositions: Extraction from free-text is heuristic and vulnerable to schema-valid decoys and fence-wrapped quoted JSON; an explicit output channel makes payload location a stated contract
The sentinel marker system uses line-anchored non-nested pairing with last-complete-block-wins semantics to extract JSON between <<<REBAR_OUTPUT>>> and <<<END>>> markers
Markerless replies fall back byte-for-byte to existing schema-filtered selection; incomplete or absent markers do not regress legacy/non-compliant model transcripts
A marker block containing invalid JSON after repair, or schema-invalid JSON with a decoy outside markers, raises StructuredOutputError (fail-closed) rather than selecting outside content
The bounded-retry prompt in structured_run.py must name the same markers as the first attempt to keep the fail-closed channel consistent across retry
The directive and extraction land in one atomic change to prevent the system from breaking between interim states where the directive alone flips behavior
